subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The employer paid him the salary.

options.text: He was paid by the employer salary.
He was being paid the salary by the employer.
The salary was paid to him by the employer.
He had been paid the salary by the employer.

solution:
The correct answer is "The salary was paid to him by the employer."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it to Passive Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'employer'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'salary'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• The verb **"paid"** becomes **"was paid"** in the passive voice, and the doer of the action (**employer**) becomes the object of the preposition **"by".** 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

Correct Sentence:__* The salary was paid to him by the employer.*
